CHO-A-19267.kennel_description:
Meet Koda, a pup with LOTS of energy and love to give! He's a 4 year-old Labrador retriever, Shepard mix. He loves tug of war and can even fetch! He has a personality that will light up any room. Koda is an adventurer with a heart of gold. He loves meeting new people and spreading the love to anyone he can! Come meet Koda today!

Koda is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on his vaccinations. You can meet him daily at the CASPCA between the hours of 12-6pm. For more information, email adoptions@caspca.org

CHO-A-21567.kennel_description: Cue is an adorable fluffy kitten who is a very curious and affectionate girl! She is an expert biscuit-maker and loves to chase her foster siblings around the house. You've got to meet this cutie!

CHO-A-84703.kennel_description:
*Fee is waived/ sponsored!*

Meet Taro!

This chatty guy has lots of love to give and plenty to say! He never misses a chance to share what’s on his mind and charms everyone he meets with his outgoing, friendly personality. He would thrive in a home where he can be the center of attention and soak up all the love as the only pet.

Taro's adoption fee has been fully sponsored! He is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on his vaccinations. You can meet him daily at the shelter between 12-6pm. For more information, email adoptions@caspca.org

CHO-A-85373.kennel_description:
* Fee is waived/ sponsored*

Niblet is handsome, goofy, and a total sweetheart! He loves to play, go on adventures, and most of all LOVES to snuggle up on the couch! He's a true all-rounder who would make a great addition to a home looking for a furry friend to brighten their day.

Niblet has done well in his foster homes, and has been noted to do well with young children. He's a social butterfly who loves meeting new people and other dogs! He also is a quick learner and enjoys learning new tricks.

Niblet is neutered, vaccinated, and microchipped. You can meet him at CASPCA every day between the hours of 12PM and 6PM. For more information on Niblet, email us at adoptions@caspca.org.

CHO-A-84319.kennel_description:
*Fee is waived/ sponsored!*

Meet Autumn!

Autumn has tons of curiosity, all the calico sass, and a really playful and silly pep in her step. Watching her interact with her environment is like watching a comedy show. She is super sweet and loves being told how gorgeous she is! She loves climbing and getting into all sorts of places where she can explore and find new things to play with.

Autumn has feline hyperesthesia, which causes sensitivity in her back and tail. Her condition is managed with medication, but it takes her time to trust all the pets(to her less-sensitive head and chin!) that she is dying to get. She instead would love to sit next you on the couch and lay at your feet at bedtime.

Autumn has so much to offer and will bring endless joy to an experienced cat owner who will appreciate all of her personality and quirks! Autumn also does get along well with other cats and with a little patience, we are certain this beautiful calico will become an amazing companion who's antics keep you entertained.

Autumn is spayed, microchipped, and up to date on her vaccinations. You can meet her daily at the CASPCA between the hours of 12-6pm. For more information, email adoptions@caspca.org

CHO-A-85567.kennel_description:
Meet Carmen!
Carmen is a little nervous being in the shelter, but she is a very sweet girl. She is a 5 year old brown tabby with a big heart. She might be a little shy at first, but she responds very well to her name when you are offering some pets!

Carmen is spayed, microchipped, and up to date on her vaccinations. You can meet her daily at CASPCA between 12pm-6pm. For more information, please email adoptions@caspca.org.

CHO-A-85719.kennel_description:
This stunning boy is Prince! When he was here as a puppy his name was Fisher and he responds to both! His nicknames are numerous and the list grows daily. Prince Fish is by far our favorite...

Prince Fish is about six and a half years old and he is the perfect mix of playful and then ready to crash on the couch. He is housetrained, respectful in the house, does well on a leash but does have some reactivity that he is working through. He is great at coexisting with dogs but if they are reactive towards him, he has to talk smack back.

More positives- he loves stuffies, water, chew bones, sunny days, a pile of blankets to snuggle in, wearing shirts, and taking treats gently. He is going to make an amazing buddy for a family or couple or anyone! He loves everyone and its so easy to love him back.

Prince is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on his vaccinations. You can meet him daily at the CASPCA between 12-6pm. For more information, email adoptions@caspca.org

CHO-A-86486.kennel_description:
Mousse is a handsome tuxedo kitty! He's an independent gentleman who enjoys relaxing in his own space. If you're looking for a companion who is happy to lounge while you do you, Mousse is your guy!

Mousse is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on his vaccinations. You can meet him 12-6 daily at CASPCA or email us at adoptions@caspca.org for more info!

CHO-A-87224.kennel_description:
Ahoy! Meet Captain Hook, a striking black domestic shorthair who's only 8 months old and ready to set sail. Due a severe injury Captain Hook did lose his front right leg and unfortunately peg legs are not a thing in the cat world. While he learns to navigate the world again he will need a patient person as he grows into his adventurous spirit! He is so sweet and loves getting scratches behind his ears. Come meet him today!

Captain Hook is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on his vaccinations. You can meet him daily at the CASPCA between the hours of 12–6 p.m. For more information, email adoptions@caspca.org.

CHO-A-87355.kennel_description:
Meet Archer!
This 8-year-old Boxer mix is ready to steal your heart! With all the charm and playfulness you'd want, he would be a devoted and loving companion. Archer is affectionate, friendly, and loyal. He will be your guy for both couch cuddles and outdoor adventures. Archer has got a mischievous, playful side that keeps life fun. Come meet Archer and see if you're a perfect match!

Archer's adoption fee has been sponsored by a generous donor! He is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on his vaccinations. You can meet him daily at the CASPCA between the hours of 12-6pm. For more information, email adoptions@caspca.org

CHO-A-87363.kennel_description:
Meet Memphis, a striking 5-year-old American Foxhound with a handsome coat and big bright eyes! He's an adventurous guy who loves to stay active and explore. He's got the love and loyalty that hounds are known for. He's affectionate and playful, especially with the people he cares about most. His friendly nature means he genuinely enjoys making new friends. If you're looking for a devoted companion who'll bring joy and excitement to your life, come meet Memphis!

Memphis is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on his vaccinations! You can meet him daily at CASPCA between 12pm-6pm. For more information, please email adoptions@caspca.org.

CHO-A-87364.kennel_description:
Look at that face!
Dalton is a five year old English Coonhound, who is ready to make some new friends! This silly fella is the ultimate snuggler. He's a playful guy who loves to be active and engaged. Dalton would be more then happy to spend the day curled up next to his favorite people. If you're looking for a lovable hound to brighten up your day, you've found him!

Dalton is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on his vaccinations! You can meet him daily at the CASPCA between the hours of 12-6pm. For more information, email adoptions@caspca.org

CHO-A-87365.kennel_description:
Meet Raleigh!
This stunning five year old treeing walker coonhound certainly is handsome, with his tricolor coat and big ole puppy eyes! Being a hound, this sweet boy loves to sniff around and get the lay of the land. He's affectionate and energetic, the perfect combo for a new best friend!

Raleigh is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on his vaccinations! You can meet him daily at CASPCA between 12pm-6pm. For more information, please email adoptions@caspca.org.

CHO-A-87366.kennel_description:
Say hi to Bristol!
This striking 5-year-old bluetick coonhound is ready for his next adventure! He's a solid 62-pound guy with that handsome blue-black and white tick coat. He's got a friendly, loyal spirit and a playful streak that makes every day fun — whether you're exploring the great outdoors or just hanging out together. If you're looking for a devoted companion with a little adventure in his heart, come meet Bristol and let's see if you're a perfect match!

Bristol is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on all of his vaccinations. You can meet him at CASPCA between the hours of 12 PM and 6 PM daily, no appointment necessary! Please email adoptions@caspca.org for additional information.

CHO-A-87530.kennel_description:
*Waived/Sponsored Adoption Fee*

Meet Papa!
This handsome 4-year-old grey and white boy is ready to find his forever home! He's a friendly guy who loves meeting new people, so he promises to be a welcoming companion in your life. Come say hello and let's see if you're a purrfect match!

Papa is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on his vaccinations. You can meet him daily at the CASPCA between the hours of 12-6pm. For more information, email adoptions@caspca.org

CHO-A-87545.kennel_description:
Meet Maple,
Ready to settle into a loving home where her friendly, loyal nature can truly shine, this 11-year-old brown tabby with a heart full of adventure and affection! At just over five pounds, she's a petite girl with big personality. Maple loves exploring her space and being close to the people she cares about. If you're looking for a senior companion who's still got plenty of love to give, She'd adore meeting you! Come visit Maple and start your next chapter together!

Maple's adoption fee has been sponsored by a generous donor! She is spayed, microchipped, and up to date on her vaccinations. You can meet her daily at the CASPCA between the hours of 12-6pm. For more information, email adoptions@caspca.org

CHO-A-87629.kennel_description:
Gnocchi acts a little aloof in the rows but there’s a sweet and silly personality hiding underneath that. She loves to roll and get pet and make biscuits in return for getting loved on. She has the cutest button nose and black beans and She’s got the classic tuxedo style, plenty of personality, and a look that is guaranteed to make you smile.

Gnocchi is spayed, microchipped, and up to date on her vaccinations! You can meet her daily at CASPCA between 12pm-6pm. For more information, please email adoptions@caspca.org.

CHO-A-87660.kennel_description:
Meet Spartacus, a 3-year-old tan and cream Husky who's ready for his next adventure! At just over 50 pounds, he's a smart, friendly guy who brings a joyous energy with him wherever he wanders. He's got the energy and intelligence that comes with his beautiful breed. Get ready to make some memories with our boy Spartacus!

Spartacus is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on all of his vaccinations. You can meet him at CASPCA between the hours of 12 PM and 6 PM daily, no appointment necessary! Please email adoptions@caspca.org for additional information.

CHO-A-87759.kennel_description:
Cellar is looking for a patient home that will teach her all about human kindness. This girl grew up outside with her siblings and had very little human interaction. We are slowly making progress with her. She loves wet food and deep comfy beds and will play with toys if no one is watching. We’ve gotten her to accept chin scratches and we are hoping the right person will be able to keep working with her in a home!

This lady is spayed, microchipped, and up to date on all of her vaccinations. You can meet her at CASPCA between the hours of 12 PM and 6 PM daily, no appointment necessary! Please email adoptions@caspca.org for additional information.

CHO-A-87858.kennel_description:
Lady Bug? More like... love bug.
Lady bug is a 6-year-old mahogany beauty with an honest and kind nature! She's a Terrier, Pit Bull mix who's affectionate, friendly, and loyal. She loves being by your side and Is always ready for a good time. She's got plenty of charming energy and will happily take the leash and walk herself by your side. Come meet Lady Bug and get to know her loving spirit! 💕

Lady Bug is spayed, microchipped, and up to date on her vaccinations. You can meet her daily at the CASPCA between the hours of 12-6pm. For more information, email adoptions@caspca.org

CHO-A-88056.kennel_description:
Oreo is a large, beautiful boy! He was originally a class room pet but has since retired! He is now looking to be a house bunny, with lots of room to explore and veggies to munch. Oreo has been in the vicinity of other rabbits but we are not sure if he has ever lived with another rabbit. He loves to stretch out and explore his enclosure, he lived in pretty tight quarters before so he is very happy with his new accommodations. If you are looking for a wonderful new floppy friend who has an amazing temperament Oreo might be your guy. Come check him out!
Oreo is neutered and ready to go to his new home today!

CHO-A-88103.kennel_description:
Meet Alfie!
This 3 year-old Terrier, Pit Bull mix is the perfect play buddy! With that handsome smile, Alfie brings a friendly energy and a playful spirit to whatever adventure he's on. This gentle boy is sure to steal your heart!

Alfie is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on his vaccinations! You can meet him daily at CASPCA between 12pm-6pm. For more information, please email adoptions@caspca.org.

CHO-A-88105.kennel_description:
Say hi to Louise!
This four year old Pit Bull Terrier is a true girls girl. With her energetic spirit and friendly nature, she's sure to charm everyone she meets. Loyal, playful, and loving, this sweetheart is the total package!

Louise is spayed, microchipped, and up to date on her vaccinations! You can meet her daily at CASPCA between 12pm-6pm. For more information, please email adoptions@caspca.org.

CHO-A-88119.kennel_description:
Meet Bambi, a 2-year-old tan and white hound girl with a heart full of love and energy to match. She's a friendly and loyal companion who brings playfulness to every moment you share together. If you're looking for a spirited medium-sized friend who'll be by your side through thick and thin, Bambi would love to meet you! Come say hello and let's start you're adventure together.

Bambi is spayed, microchipped, and up to date on her vaccinations! You can meet her daily at the CASPCA between the hours of 12-6pm. For more information, email adoptions@caspca.org

CHO-A-88147.kennel_description:
Say hi to Callo!
This three year old Pit Bull Terrier is quite the charmer! He's a friendly, playful guy who loves to make the most of every moment! The key to his heart is through stuffies and cuddles.

Callo is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on his vaccinations! You can meet him daily at the CASPCA between the hours of 12-6pm. For more information, email adoptions@caspca.org

CHO-A-88184.kennel_description:
Meet Ronnie, a spirited 1-year-old Beagle-Pug mix with a tan coat and a whole lot of heart! At 26 pounds, he's the perfect medium-sized adventure buddy who's ready to roll. He's energetic and playful! So, he brings fun and friendliness wherever he goes. He can't wait to meet his forever family and make some beautiful memories!

Ronnie is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on his vaccinations. You can meet him daily at the CASPCA between the hours of 12-6pm. For more information, email adoptions@caspca.org

CHO-A-88205.kennel_description:
Have you ever wanted 40lbs of marmalade? Well, it is your lucky day because we have two 20lb orange brothers that are looking to go home together. Oscar and Hopper are bestest brothers and they can't imagine life without each other.
They will need to go on a weight-loss journey for sure but they are happy to exchange treats for snuggles. The cutest thing about these two is they love napping together. Hopper loves to sleep under the covers and will climb up under comforters and blankets and take a cat nap. Oscar sometimes will join his brother underneath but other times you can see him on top of the covers marking where his brother is hiding.
If you would love to be a third wheel to this tangerine duo we highly recommend you talk to an adoption counselor today and get their information! They are currently hanging out in a foster home so they can start getting their steps in.

Hopper and Oscar are vaccinated, neutered, microchipped and ready to go home today. Reach out to the Charlottesville-Albemarle SPCA today so you can meet them.

Honestly... who would not want a dog like this? Meet Little Man!
This 9 year-old gentleman is ready to show some love to his new people! He's a Labrador Retriever mix with a heart aged to perfection. Come meet Little Man today!

Say hey to Bluey!

Bluey is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on all of his vaccinations. You can meet him at CASPCA between the hours of 12 PM and 6 PM daily, no appointment necessary! Please email adoptions@caspca.org for additional information.
